summary: This Form 6-K reports a routine CFO appointment at Titan Mining Corp. Richard Pozzebon was named CFO effective July 6, 2026, replacing an undisclosed predecessor. The filing is a standard material change report under Canadian rules, with no departure of a named incumbent executive as an abrupt event. There are no terms, premiums, or structural notes typically associated with special situations. This is an ordinary management appointment, not a forced management change or any other special category. The analogous US equivalent would be a Form 8-K Item 5.02 filing. No special-situation deal terms or risk-arb angle are present.
